AMENDMENTTOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AMENDMENTTOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT(this "Amendment"), entered into as of October 9. 2012, by and between AUGUSTUS H. LA WRENCE & CO. LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office 96 Greenwich Street, New York, New York 10006 ("Owner"), and BRISAM GREENWICH LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at 420 Great Neck Road, Great Neck, New York 11021("Developer"). WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements located thereon,in the County of NewYork, City and State of NewYork, known as and by the street address 96 Greenwich Street,tax lot Block 53,Lot 39 and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Property"); and WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements located thereon, in the County of NewYork, City and State of New York,known as and by the street address 98/100 Greenwich Street, tax lot Block 53,Lot 38 and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lot being referred to herein as "Developer's Property"); and interest, and Developer executed and delivered (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, which was recorded on April 24,2008in the Office of the City Register of the City of NewYork under CRFN no. 208000166014, pursuant to which Owner's Land and Developer's Land were declared to be a single zoning lot for the purposes of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, and (ii) a Zoning Lot Development Agreement (the “ZLDA"), which was recorded on 208000166013,pursuant to which, inter alia, certain Floor Area Development Rights (as defined in the ZLDA) were transferred from Owner's Property to Developer's Property; and WHEREAS, Owner and Developer wish to transfer the 21,739 square feet of the Floor Area Development Rights previously transferred to Developer's Property (the “Reacquired Development Rights") back from Developer's Property to Owner's Property and, in connection therewith, to amend the ZLDA to reflect such a transfer. NOW, THEREFORE,in consideration of the terms and provisions herein contained, effective as of the date hereof, theZLDA is hereby amended as follows: 1. By this Amendment, Developer hereby transfers to Owner the Reacquired Development Rights. 2. Immediately after the transfer of the Reacquired Development Rights to Owner's Property, the ZLDA, as amended hereby, shall be deemed terminated and of no further force and effect. 1
